name: ps2cc
description: PS2CC: PS2-era character creator that exports Humanoid-ready FBX for Unity

scripts.build:landmarks: pnpm --filter @ps2cc/app-frontend exec playwright test -c playwright.tools.config.ts build-landmarks
scripts.build:scanskin: pnpm --filter @ps2cc/app-frontend exec playwright test -c playwright.tools.config.ts build-scan-skin
scripts.build:materials: pnpm --filter @ps2cc/app-frontend exec playwright test -c playwright.tools.config.ts build-materials
scripts.export:testchars: pnpm --filter @ps2cc/app-frontend exec playwright test -c playwright.tools.config.ts export-testchars
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm --filter @ps2cc/app-frontend exec playwright test -c playwright.tools.config.ts desktop
scripts.test:painter: pnpm --filter @ps2cc/app-frontend exec playwright test -c playwright.tools.config.ts material-painter
